standards_review.notes: 5 subjects in range all use type fix with allowed scope analytics, imperative mood, lengths 77-93 chars within the 100-char subject-max-length in git-workflow.md
claude-baseline.ts conforms; claude.metrics-processor.ts grows to 525 lines (>500), collectRunPromptsAndInvocations ~65 lines (>50), messages: any[] undocumented
no hardcoded secrets or console.log; new logs carry only ids/caller/cutoff/counts/error; runtimeCheckpoint follows existing createSessionRecord pattern

findings.title: Unreadable session skips baseline and re-sends history
findings.problem: processSession step 1b reads baselineCutoffMs from sessionStore.loadSession(sessionId). loadSession swallows read/parse errors and returns null (SessionStore.ts:65-75), and saveSession writes non-atomically, so a concurrent write can yield a transient null. baselineCutoffMs then stays undefined, the baseline is skipped without error, and the metrics/conversations processors reload the (now readable) session and process the whole transcript on a record that still carries the marker.
findings.impact: On a resumed Claude transcript the run re-sends every metric record, prompt, invocation and conversation entry an earlier session already synced, violating EPMCDME-16537's 'no failure path re-sends them'. Reachability unconfirmed: requires a transient unreadable session file between step 1b and the processors' own load.
findings.recommendation: In processSession step 1b, when loadSession returns null, return the same failed 'baseline' result (success:false, failedProcessors ['baseline'], totalRecords 0) instead of falling through to the processors; only proceed without a baseline when the session loaded and carries no baselineCutoffMs.

findings.title: collectRunPromptsAndInvocations exceeds 50-line limit
findings.problem: code-quality.md sets functions under 50 lines; the newly added collectRunPromptsAndInvocations is ~65 lines and mixes prompt extraction with final-pass record marking.
findings.impact: Documented code-quality standard is broken by a newly added function; standards audit marks code-quality partial.
findings.recommendation: Split the finalPass record-marking block (the `if (finalPass && !namedOnly)` section) into its own private helper returning promptsDelta.

findings.title: Undocumented any[] parameter on new method
findings.problem: code-quality.md Type Annotations allow any only with a documented reason; the new parameter `messages: any[]` has no justifying comment while the method otherwise uses ClaudeMessage.
findings.impact: Documented type-annotation rule is unmet on newly added code; weakens type safety of the per-run prompt path.
findings.recommendation: Type the `messages` parameter as `ClaudeMessage[]`, or add a one-line comment explaining why `any[]` is required.

findings.title: Metrics processor file exceeds 500 lines
findings.problem: code-quality.md Code Structure Guidelines set files under 500 lines; this change grows claude.metrics-processor.ts from 412 to 525 lines.
findings.impact: Documented code-quality standard is broken by lines this change introduced.
findings.recommendation: Move the new per-run prompt/invocation helpers (collectRunPromptsAndInvocations, isStampedBefore, isTypedPromptText) into a co-located module such as session/processors/run-prompts.ts.

findings.title: Baseline group and untimestamped-line rules untested
findings.problem: regression-gap: takeMessagesBefore's new rules (every line of one message.id group follows the group's first line; a line without a timestamp follows the previous stamped line) have no test. Every claude-run-baseline and adapter-baseline fixture gives each assistant line its own message.id and every line a timestamp; only the out-of-order synthetic reply is exercised.
findings.impact: Consumers ConversationsProcessor.computeBaselinePointer and MetricsProcessor.computeBaselineRecordIds (via applyClaudeBaseline from the CLI and Desktop adapters): dropping the group map or defaulting untimestamped lines to after-cutoff would place the baseline pointer mid-turn and re-send or skip part of a turn on resume, with no failing test.
findings.recommendation: Add a baseline test where one assistant message.id has chunks stamped on both sides of the cutoff, plus a line with no timestamp after a pre-cutoff line; assert computeBaselinePointer's lastSyncedHistoryIndex/lastSyncedMessageUuid, the seeded processedRecordIds, and that the run neither duplicates nor drops that group.

deferred.title: Subagent Task prompt counted as user prompt
deferred.problem: When the main transcript attached no prompt this run, a subagent's runLines go through extractUserPrompts and its Task prompt is counted as a typed prompt.
deferred.preexisting: main already attached subagent userPromptsMap when attachedUserPrompts was empty; namedOnly only narrows trailing lines

deferred.title: Final pass runs only on SessionEnd
deferred.problem: Sessions ending by reaping, SIGTERM/abort or Desktop teardown never get finalPass, so trailing unanswered prompts and pending invocations are dropped.
deferred.preexisting: trailing prompts were never counted before this change; the task scopes the new rule to SessionEnd

deferred.title: In-REPL /resume re-entry gets no baseline
deferred.problem: A live record re-entered by SessionStart(source=resume) with a new transcript_path sets no baselineCutoffMs, so that transcript's history can be sent again.
deferred.preexisting: re-entry path is unchanged; the task covers --resume/--continue CLI runs that create a fresh record
